_how_to_use: Email sign-up stays in a friendly 'opening soon' state until provider AND form_action are both filled in. Recommended provider: "brevo". After creating the Brevo sign-up form (Marketing > Forms > Sign-up, Double confirmation ON), open Share > HTML, copy the form's action URL (https://....sibforms.com/serve/....) into form_action and check the field names match the attribute names in your Brevo form. The Brevo API key for the private stats dashboard is NEVER stored here: set BREVO_API_KEY when running scripts/stats.py. See emails/README.md for the full setup.
